entry.title: langgraph==1.2.15
entry.content:
Changes since 1.2.14

  • release(langgraph): 1.2.15 (#9283)
  • fix(langgraph): give every message written to a messages DeltaChannel an id (#9275)
  • fix(langgraph): save a cached node's writes like a node that ran (#9259)
  • fix(langgraph): stop at an interrupt_before breakpoint when a drain is requested before it (#9281)
  • fix(langgraph): keep an exit run from a checkpoint the thread moved past out of its newer branch (#9269)
  • fix(langgraph): store an update_state input's writes on the checkpoint it updates (#9258)
  • fix(langgraph): read a run's DeltaChannel input back only on its own checkpoints (#9260)
  • fix(langgraph): snapshot a DeltaChannel that an update_state Overwrite resets (#9263)
  • fix(langgraph): keep a fork's DeltaChannel snapshot from starting nodes that never ran (#9264)
  • fix(langgraph): don't save a checkpoint past a failed DeltaChannel write (#9235)
  • fix(langgraph,prebuilt): stop ToolNode from swallowing invalid resume values (#9232)
  • fix(langgraph): never store exit-mode delta writes under the null task id (#9229)
  • fix(langgraph): stop astream_events dropping control/interrupts on v1/v2 (#9219)
  • chore(deps): bump notebook from 7.5.7 to 7.6.3 in /libs/langgraph (#9206)
  • fix(langgraph): give each bulk_update_state update its own task id (#9128)
  • fix(langgraph): replay a resumed exit-mode run's delta writes in live order (#9114)
  • fix: order delta channel replay by task path (#8544)
